author: Web Team

findings.title: Category pages load hero images without size hints
findings.description: Images on category pages have no width and height, so the layout shifts while they load.
findings.recommendation: Set width and height on every hero image.

findings.title: 212 URLs return a redirect chain
findings.description: Old product URLs redirect twice before reaching the current page.
findings.recommendation: Point each old URL directly at its final target.

note: Two findings are open; the next review is in April.
